values.Text: How exactly does it work? Well, the Sun is constantly sending heat and light to Earth.

values.Text: When the particles bump into nitrogen in our atmosphere, it makes blue and purple light. Earth is not the only planet with auroras.

values.Text: Even though auroras are best seen at night, these colorful displays are caused by our ever-changing Sun.
